university.name: Ravensbourne University London
university.summary: Ravensbourne University London is based at Greenwich Peninsula, London. Its international students page states that it holds a Home Office sponsor licence, that applications are considered individually, and that creative courses typically require a portfolio or showreel.
university.eligibility_note: Institution states it holds a Home Office sponsor licence (own international students page); gov.uk register file not opened

courses.title: Graphic Design
courses.duration_text: 3 years (4 years with Integrated Foundation Year)
courses.overview: Full-time undergraduate degree in graphic design at the Greenwich Peninsula campus, also offered with an optional Integrated Foundation Year. Admission to the three-year route is subject to a portfolio or showreel.
highlights: Module titles listed for 2027/28 entry and subject to revalidation
courses.academic_requirements: GCSE Grade 4 or above in English, plus one of: two A Levels at CC or above; BTEC Extended Diploma at MPP; UAL Level 3 Extended Diploma; T Level (pass or above); Access to Higher Education Diploma; International Baccalaureate at 24 or above; or other qualifications equivalent to 64 UCAS Tariff points. Admission subject to successful completion of a portfolio (or showreel).
courses.experience_requirements: Portfolio (or showreel) required for the three-year route; none required for the Integrated Foundation Year route.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The country-specific page does not list Pakistan requirements; it names Pakistan among South Asian countries and directs applicants to OIEG.
courses.notes: Course page states only GCSE English for language; IELTS band not stated on this page. Fee applies to 2026/27 entry, subject to change for 2027/28.

courses.title: Computer Science with International Year One
courses.overview: Three-year full-time computing degree that includes an International Year One, with no interview or portfolio required. Study covers software development, algorithms, data science and artificial intelligence.
highlights: Year 1: Computer Systems, Software Development 1, Databases
Year 2: Algorithms, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence
Year 3: Cyber Security, Machine Learning, Final Major Project
Page does not state which modules are optional
courses.academic_requirements: GCSE English and Maths at Grade 4 or above, an A Level (or equivalent Level 3) STEM subject, plus one of: two A Levels at BC or above; BTEC Extended Diploma at MMP; UAL Level 3 Extended Diploma; T Level (pass or above); Access to HE Diploma; International Baccalaureate with at least 24 points; or equivalent to 72 UCAS Tariff points.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 5.5 overall with 5.5 in each skill area, or equivalent CEFR B2 (stated for visa purposes).
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The country-specific page does not list Pakistan requirements; it names Pakistan among South Asian countries and directs applicants to OIEG.
courses.notes: Fee applies to 2026/27 entry, subject to change for 2027/28; target year fee not yet published.

courses.title: Business Management with International Year One
courses.overview: Three-year full-time business degree that includes an International Year One. Study spans management, finance, law, operations and entrepreneurship, ending with a consultancy project and an individual project.
highlights: Year 1: Markets, Customers and Sales Practice; Finance for Decision Making
Year 2: Business Law, Ops and Project Management
Page lists modules as indicative (modules may include)
courses.academic_requirements: GCSE Grade 4 or above in English, plus one of: two A Levels at CC or above; BTEC Extended Diploma at MPP; UAL Level 3 Extended Diploma; T Level (pass or above); Access to HE Diploma; International Baccalaureate at 24 or above; or equivalent to 64 UCAS Tariff points.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS 5.5 overall, with no component below 5.5, or an equivalent qualification listed on the university website.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The country-specific page does not list Pakistan requirements; it names Pakistan among South Asian countries and directs applicants to OIEG.
courses.notes: Fee applies to 2026/27 entry, subject to change for 2027/28; target year fee not yet published.

courses.title: International Finance
courses.overview: One-year full-time master's in finance covering financial markets, corporate finance, risk management and a final project. The course page notes CMI Level 7 accreditation.
courses.academic_requirements: The page does not give international grades; it refers applicants to the country-specific entry requirements page and asks for a CV or resume. Applicants without formal qualifications may be considered based on aptitude and professional skills.
courses.english_requirements: For a Student Visa: IELTS (or equivalent) 6.0 overall with at least 5.5 in each sub-test, or CEFR B2 in each component.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The country-specific page does not list Pakistan requirements; it names Pakistan among South Asian countries and directs applicants to OIEG.
courses.notes: Course page showed September 2026 and January 2027 starts only; no September 2027 start visible. Fee confirmed on the international postgraduate fees page for students starting 2026/27 (MA/MSc 18,500); target year fee not yet published. No degree class stated.

scholarships.name: Undergraduate International Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 5,000 off the GBP 17,500 fee on undergraduate creative courses (final fee GBP 12,500). Other amounts apply to Business Management and Computer Science courses.
scholarships.summary: Reduction in international tuition fees for undergraduate applicants classified as overseas for fee purposes who have accepted an offer and enrolled. Amounts vary by course, with a different schedule for the International Year One degrees.
scholarships.criteria_text: Applicants who have accepted their offer, enrolled, and are classified as overseas students for fee purposes. Business Management with International Year One: GBP 4,950 (Year 1) and GBP 3,000 (Years 2 and 3). Computer Science with International Year One: GBP 3,500, GBP 4,500 and GBP 5,500 (Years 1 to 3). Business Management with Fashion, Cyber Security, Digital Marketing and IT Management: GBP 3,850 off GBP 17,500.
scholarships.intake_label: 2026/27 terms; 2027 entry terms not yet published
scholarships.notes: Page does not say whether the amount is per year for the creative courses, and does not say how it is applied. Terms shown are for 2026/27.

scholarships.name: Postgraduate International Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 3,500 to GBP 6,000 off tuition depending on course; GBP 6,000 for MSc International Finance.
scholarships.summary: Reduction in international tuition fees for postgraduate applicants classified as overseas for fee purposes. The amount depends on the course, from GBP 3,500 to GBP 6,000, and second-year awards on industry-year courses require full payment.
scholarships.criteria_text: Applicants who have accepted their offer, enrolled, and are classified as overseas students for fee purposes. GBP 6,000 applies to MSc International Finance, International Fashion Marketing, Information Technology Management, Engineering Management, Events Management, Software Engineering, MA Luxury Brand Management and MA Digital Photography. GBP 4,500 applies to a further list of MSc courses. GBP 4,000 applies to MBA. GBP 3,500 per year applies to MFA.
scholarships.intake_label: 2026/27 terms; 2027 entry terms not yet published
scholarships.notes: Terms shown are for 2026/27. Value basis not stated for single-year courses.

scholarships.name: Early payment discount
scholarships.value_text: GBP 1,000 off full tuition fees paid 60 days before Semester 1 starts; or GBP 900 in total when paying in stages
scholarships.summary: Discount for international students who pay early. Paying in full 60 days before Semester 1 gives GBP 1,000 off; the staged option gives GBP 500 plus GBP 400, GBP 900 in total.
scholarships.criteria_text: Pay full tuition 60 days before Semester 1 starts (GBP 1,000 off), or pay at least GBP 2,000 sixty days before Welcome Week (GBP 500 off) and the remainder before travelling to the UK (a further GBP 400 off).
scholarships.deadline_note: 60 days before Welcome Week or Semester 1; no calendar date given
scholarships.intake_label: 2026/27 terms; 2027 entry terms not yet published
scholarships.notes: An older fees page (2024/25 and 2025/26) states a GBP 1,000 discount for payment 28 days before start and says it is not available for BSc Business Management with International Year One; the newer scholarships page states 60 days. Treat as conflicting until confirmed.
